name: 网页转 Markdown 笔记
description: 抓取网页正文并转换为结构化的 Markdown 笔记，便于保存到知识库或笔记应用。

display_description.en: Fetch a web page's main content and convert it into clean Markdown notes for saving and editing.
display_description.zh: 把网页正文抓取并转换为结构化 Markdown 笔记，支持保存与二次编辑，适合知识整理与收藏归档。

default_init_input.zh: 把这篇网页转成 Markdown 笔记：https://example.com/article
default_init_input.en: Convert this web page into a Markdown note: https://example.com/article

quick_inputs.zh: 把这篇网页转成 Markdown 笔记：https://example.com/article
quick_inputs.en: Convert this web page into a Markdown note: https://example.com/article

quick_inputs.zh: 抓取这个链接的正文并整理成笔记：https://example.com/post
quick_inputs.en: Fetch this link's content and organize it into a note: https://example.com/post

quick_inputs.zh: 把这篇网页内容保存为 .md 文件

display_description.en: Fetches a web page by URL and converts its main content into Markdown.
